title: Exploded Core System
description: A four-image continuity series following one industrial device from hero assembly to controlled exploded documentation.
creative_direction: Image 01 defines one original industrial device and its material logic. Images 02-04 depend on it and preserve the exact product identity while progressively opening the assembly and converting the render into technical communication.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-context-shift, 03-surface-study, 04-presentation-master. Queue may run later images concurrently after 01-reference-anchor is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
